name: Independence of Bolivia
description: After a series of revolutions and wars against Spanish occupation, Bolivia declared independence from Spain.

name: War of the Pacific
description: A conflict between Chile and the joint forces of Bolivia and Peru. Bolivia lost its access to the Pacific Ocean in this war

name: Chaco War
description: Between Bolivia and Paraguay over control of the northern part of the Gran Chaco region.

name: Bolivian National Revolution
description: The period of profound social, economic, and political changes, including universal suffrage, education and agrarian reform, and the nationalization of tin mines.

name: Banzer Dictatorship
description: Hugo Banzer, supported by the US, led a successful coup d'etat and ruled as dictator until 1978, known for its harsh authoritarian rule and violations of human rights.

name: Democratic Transition
description: Bolivia transitioned from authoritarian military rule to democracy, culminating in the election of Hernán Siles Zuazo as president.

name: Gas War
description: A civil conflict sparked by plans to export natural gas, which was widely opposed due to concerns about sovereignty and economic exploitation.

name: Election of Evo Morales
description: Evo Morales, the country's first indigenous president, was elected, marking a significant moment in the recognition of indigenous rights and culture.

name: Bolivia becomes a Plurinational State
description: A new constitution was established, declaring the country a Plurinational State and recognizing the rights of its indigenous peoples.

name: Transition to Post-Evo Morales era
description: Instability and change following Evo Morales' forced resignation and subsequent exile, leading to a 2020 election and hopes for political stability.
